fire: The baby was woken by the dog barking downstairs.
Every morning he wakens before the sun is up.
She had never been woken so early on a Sunday.
The patient wakened slowly after the long surgery.
We were woken at dawn by roosters in the yard.
Try not to waken the children while you tidy up.
The soldiers were woken by the bugle at five.
The princess wakens after a hundred years of sleep.
quiet: The baby was startled by the dog barking downstairs.
